# Domain rules: demo (docs/research/domain-rules.md)

- **Precedence.** Accepted decision records override this file.
- **Changes.** Runs propose changes and never edit this file.
- **Decision-critical** means an input a decision depends on.

```markdown
### <rule-id>: <the rule>
- Check: <how>
```

## 1. When information counts as known

### known-at-publication: A figure counts as known at its publication time.
- Check: every input names its publication time.
- Scope: decision-critical
- Source: requester, 2026-10-01
- Added: 2026-10-01
- Host: demo-app

## 2. What settles each claim type here

### measurements-name-their-sample: Every measurement names its sample.
- Check: every measurement names its sample.
- Scope: all
- Source: requester, 2026-10-01
- Added: 2026-10-01
- Retired: 2026-10-05; replaced by the protocol's standards
